value.message: Town of Oakville has Preschool Swim (3-5, no parent in water) Saturdays 9:00-9:30 and 9:40-10:10, Sept 12 to Nov 28 - their site says. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents; fees aren't posted yet, just that they're in the current Recreation Guide. I'll keep watching and text you when the fees are up.
